document: DENS CAKRA Frontend Visual Page Blueprint

summary.purpose: Page-by-page visual composition aligned with the API and App Router mappings.

globalRules.primaryCardRule: Only one visually dominant primary panel per viewport.
globalRules.filterState: URL search params are the source of truth.
globalRules.actions: Render from server availableActions and use explicit action endpoints.
globalRules.maps: Controlled mapcn viewport with server-scoped bbox/zoom queries.
